metaDescription: Kevin points viewers to whokilledthescientists.com, a free site of dossiers on scientists who died mysteriously and may be linked to a larger story.
summary: Kevin announces whokilledthescientists.com, a free website collecting information on scientists who died under mysterious circumstances. He says overnight research turned up five or six more scientists who worked on the same projects and at the same institutions as the others, and that he made dossiers on each. Kevin argues the full breadth of the deaths must be understood before any theories about who is responsible or why.
